text:
Equal volumes of solids and liquids experience different changes of volume when they are
heated through the same temperature range.
What is the reason for this?
A
The average increase in separation of the particles in a liquid is greater than the average
increase in separation of those in a solid.
B
The average increase in separation of the particles in a liquid is less than the average
increase in separation of those in a solid.
C
The particles in liquids expand by less than those in solids.
D
The particles in liquids expand by more than those in solids.
